race.comment: BEAU STRADA (5) looks a big chance after some key scratchings and a much better third at Traralgon, beaten just over a length as the well-supported favourite. The wide draw is the obvious complication, but she is third-up, proven around this distance and has the peaks to challenge. ALTRUIST (3) rates the immediate threat after only missing by a length first-up at Echuca. Is sure to have come on from tat and is drawn the A1. Gets a good shot at breaking a long run of outs. EPIC CENTRE (1) bounced back to form fourth-up with a brave on-pace effort, only collared late. Strips rock-hard fit and can give another bold sight from a favourable draw. BRONCO REVOLUTION (8) doesn't win out of turn but shoulders peaks that are competitive. Keep her onside.
